name: JJ's Sushi and Pho
notes: No website, no delivery-platform presence found (checked DoorDash, and Grubhub/Uber Eats searches turned up nothing for this address), and five tier-5 aggregators (sagemenu, zmenu, restaurantguru, top-menus, restaurantji) all had zero prices. Fell back to Yelp's photo gallery, which is allowed for dated menu photographs (not the barred user Menu tab). Filtered 35+ gallery images for alt text containing 'menu' and found 11 photos of the restaurant's actual printed dine-in menu (Yelp reports 39 total tagged 'Menu'), confirmed as this exact restaurant/address by a photo showing 'JJ Sushi & Pho, 111 Olive Drive Suite E, San Ysidro, CA 92173' printed on the menu itself. Read all pages: Appetizers, Soup and Salad, Beverages, Pho, Traditional Rolls, Asian Dishes (Fried Rice/Beef/Chicken/Shrimp), Healthy Food, Teriyaki Combo Plate, Sushi Combo Special, and Sushi (Nigiri/Hand Rolls/Sashimi). One page (Appetizers/Soup/Beverages) appeared in two photographed eras with different prices (Garlic Edamame $8.98 vs $9.98, Iced Tea $1.98 vs $2.50); used the higher-price version since two of the three photos of that page agreed on it and it is more likely the current one. Traditional Roll T18 'Vegetables Roll' had no visible price in the photo and was dropped. Menu items T10-T17 numbering repeats a '10' in the source photo (T11 Shrimp Tempura Roll, then T10 Spicy Albacore Roll) — transcribed exactly as printed, not corrected.
